test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Get out of hand
solution:
The correct answer is **Lose control**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Get out of hand: **​ to become difficult to control.

 
 
• **Example: **This matter is **getting out of hand** now. 
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is **Lose control**.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
